name: Whatsapp Marketing Automation
headline: WhatsApp Marketing Automation: Bulk Message Sender
short_description: Automates WhatsApp message sending to multiple contacts by reading phone numbers from CSV and message content from text files via WhatsApp Web.
author: CCventure

sections.overview:
This skill automates sending messages through WhatsApp Web using Python and Selenium, eliminating manual message composition for each contact. It reads phone numbers from a CSV file and message content from a text file, then programmatically sends the same message to all specified recipients. The tool controls a Chrome browser to interact with WhatsApp Web, requiring manual login before automation begins. It's designed for marketers, teams, and businesses that need to send bulk messages without third-party WhatsApp APIs. Setup involves configuring file paths, preparing a CSV with phone numbers, and specifying message text.
Send promotional messages to customer contact lists
Distribute marketing announcements to bulk phone number databases
Automate notification delivery via WhatsApp Web
Conduct outreach campaigns without manual message typing
sections.setup:

